stations.title: Odette
stations.say: Why is the listings box blank?

stations.title: Listings screen
stations.text: Asks for an address nobody checked.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Answers any page it is asked for by name.

captions: At Heronsgate Community Radio, Odette wants the studio's listings screen back.
The screen asks for an address nobody understands, and gets nothing to show.
You take addresses apart, put them together, and send a real request.
The cupboard server answers, and the listings appear on the screen.
An address is parts, not just text. Now the screen asks for the right one.
